public.research_request: These are paired-end Illumina reads from HG005 (Homo sapiens). Align them to GRCh38 and call germline variants; I need a VCF, the reference FASTA, and whether the sample carries the ALDH2 variant rs671.

prepared_answers.reason: Paired-end Illumina reads of HG005 for germline calling: genomic DNA, paired.
The request names GRCh38; the current RefSeq GRCh38 is GCF_000001405.40 (GRCh38.p14).
